pages.title: Cheetah
pages.text: The cheetah ($(o)Acinonyx jubatus$()) is a slender big cat of the open savannas and grasslands of Africa, with a small remaining population in Iran.$(br2)It is the fastest land animal, reaching around 100 km/h in short sprints. Its semi-retractable claws grip the ground like running spikes.$(br2)Female cheetahs live alone with their cubs, while males often form small coalitions, usually of brothers.
